rationale: The negative half of the tag channel, and the class that made it necessary: a value that merely CONTAINS tag-looking characters is not a tag. If the tag reader were a substring match, all three of these would produce declared_type edges and one would produce a file import. Forbidding the edge on all three is what pins the reader to the `tag` NODE.

_everyRelationshipCarries.note: asserted by the lane census over 1,274 corpus files: 308,987/308,987 relationships carry a 1-based line_number and an evidenceClass
